purpose: Independent re-verification that Defect D -- unattested core.transactions lineage owned by a run that can never reach a terminal status -- has exactly one instance on this task's acceptance surface. Sweeps EVERY non-terminal run in the source database, not only the orders backfill, so a second instance cannot hide behind the one already known.

classification_rule.acceptance_gate: forecast_training_view.source_run_complete is a bool_and over runs joined through canonical_lineage WHERE canonical_table = 'core.transactions'. Lineage for any other canonical table cannot poison it.
classification_rule.permanence: A non-terminal run is PERMANENTLY stale once its partition already has a SUCCEEDED run: the successor finished, so nothing will ever transition the abandoned row. Without such a successor the run is still IN FLIGHT and is expected to settle on its own -- this is the same criterion the finisher gate uses, so the two cannot disagree.

sweep_sql: SELECT r.run_id::text, r.source_kind, r.partition_key, r.status, r.started_at, r.processed_count, l.canonical_table, count(l.*) AS lineage_rows, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM data_plane.ingestion_runs s WHERE s.source_kind = r.source_kind AND s.partition_key = r.partition_key AND s.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS partition_has_succeeded_run FROM data_plane.ingestion_runs r LEFT JOIN data_plane.canonical_lineage l ON l.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUCCEEDED' OR r.finished_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5,6,7 ORDER BY r.started_at
